queries.name: CAVAS_CLIENTS_PROFILE
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vip_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN email IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(email)) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_email,
    SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(phone)) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_phone,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max,
    MIN(last_visit) AS last_visit_min,
    MAX(last_visit) AS last_visit_max
FROM dbo.clients

queries.name: CAVAS_CLIENT_DUPLICATE_EMAILS
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(email))) AS email_normalized,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count
FROM dbo.clients
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(email)) <> ''
GROUP BY LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(email)))
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1
ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC, email_normalized

queries.name: CAVAS_CLIENT_TYPES
queries.sql:
SELECT
    type,
    relation_type,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count
FROM dbo.clients
GROUP BY type, relation_type
ORDER BY rows_count DESC

queries.name: CAVAS_CELLARS_PROFILE
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_cellars,
    SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_cellars,
    SUM(COALESCE(bottle_count,0)) AS stored_bottle_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(client_count,0)) AS stored_client_count,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max
FROM dbo.cellars

queries.name: CAVAS_CELLARS_CLIENTS_CARDINALITY
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS links_total,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT cellar_id) AS linked_cellars,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT client_id) AS linked_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cellar_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_cellar,
    SUM(CASE WHEN client_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_client
FROM dbo.cellars_clients

queries.name: CAVAS_CELLARS_WITH_MULTIPLE_CLIENTS
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    cellar_id,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients_count
FROM dbo.cellars_clients
WHERE cellar_id IS NOT NULL
  AND client_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cellar_id
HAVING COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT client_id) > 1
ORDER BY clients_count DESC, cellar_id

queries.name: CAVAS_CLIENTS_WITH_MULTIPLE_CELLARS
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    client_id,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT cellar_id) AS cellars_count
FROM dbo.cellars_clients
WHERE cellar_id IS NOT NULL
  AND client_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY client_id
HAVING COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT cellar_id) > 1
ORDER BY cellars_count DESC, client_id

queries.name: CAVAS_BOTTLES_PROFILE
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_bottles,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT cellar_id) AS cellars_with_bottles,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cellar_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bottles_without_cellar,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max
FROM dbo.bottles

queries.name: CAVAS_BOTTLE_STATUS
queries.sql:
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count
FROM dbo.bottles
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY rows_count DESC

queries.name: CAVAS_BOTTLE_CAPACITY
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    capacity,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count
FROM dbo.bottles
GROUP BY capacity
ORDER BY rows_count DESC, capacity

queries.name: CAVAS_BOTTLES_ORPHAN_CELLAR
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS orphan_bottles
FROM dbo.bottles b
LEFT JOIN dbo.cellars c
  ON c.id = b.cellar_id
WHERE b.cellar_id IS NOT NULL
  AND c.id IS NULL

queries.name: CAVAS_BOTTLE_LOG_ACTIONS
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    action,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max
FROM dbo.bottle_logs
GROUP BY action
ORDER BY rows_count DESC, action

queries.name: CAVAS_BOTTLE_LOG_PROFILE
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_logs,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT bottle_id) AS bottles_logged,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT cellar_id) AS cellars_logged,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients_logged,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT user_id) AS users_logged,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT attendance_id) AS attendances_logged,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bottle_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_bottle,
    SUM(CASE WHEN client_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_client,
    SUM(CASE WHEN attendance_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_attendance,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max
FROM dbo.bottle_logs

queries.name: CAVAS_BOTTLE_LOG_ORPHANS
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN bl.bottle_id IS NOT NULL AND b.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_bottle_refs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bl.cellar_id IS NOT NULL AND c.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_cellar_refs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bl.client_id IS NOT NULL AND cl.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_client_refs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bl.attendance_id IS NOT NULL AND a.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_attendance_refs
FROM dbo.bottle_logs bl
LEFT JOIN dbo.bottles b ON b.id = bl.bottle_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.cellars c ON c.id = bl.cellar_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.clients cl ON cl.id = bl.client_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.attendances a ON a.id = bl.attendance_id

queries.name: CAVAS_ATTENDANCES_PROFILE
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_attendances,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients_with_attendance,
    SUM(CASE WHEN client_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_client,
    SUM(COALESCE(ticket_total,0)) AS ticket_total_sum,
    SUM(COALESCE(person_amount,0)) AS person_amount_sum,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max
FROM dbo.attendances

queries.name: CAVAS_ATTENDANCE_CLIENT_ORPHANS
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS orphan_attendances
FROM dbo.attendances a
LEFT JOIN dbo.clients c
  ON c.id = a.client_id
WHERE a.client_id IS NOT NULL
  AND c.id IS NULL

queries.name: CAVAS_CLIENT_NOTES_PROFILE
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_notes,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients_with_notes,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT user_id) AS users_authoring_notes,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max
FROM dbo.client_notes

queries.name: CAVAS_USERS_PROFILE
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_users,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT role_id) AS role_ids,
    MIN(created) AS created_min,
    MAX(created) AS created_max,
    MAX(last_login) AS latest_login
FROM dbo.users

queries.name: CAVAS_MEDIA_MODEL_USAGE
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    model,
    collection,
    type,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count
FROM dbo.media
GROUP BY model, collection, type
ORDER BY rows_count DESC

queries.name: CAVAS_LOG_MODEL_ACTION_USAGE
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    model,
    action,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count
FROM dbo.logs
GROUP BY model, action
ORDER BY rows_count DESC
